data.text:
What a moment. What a milestone. What a blessing.

Moonlettes 🌙

Seeing Kolette in What Lies Beneath and now we reach #3 trending in the Philippines is something that fills our hearts with so much joy, pride, and gratitude. This is a reflection of countless people who felt something real, who connected with her performance, and who saw the sincerity she poured into every single scene.

Kolette, this is your acting era, and we are witnessing it with teary eyes and full hearts. You didn’t just play a role—you lived it. Every emotion, every silence, every breakdown felt honest and raw. You showed vulnerability, strength, and depth, and you proved that you are an artist who is constantly growing and bravely stepping into her purpose.

To everyone who watched, shared, tweeted, posted, and spoke kindly about Kolette—thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Thank you for appreciating her, for recognizing her hard work, and for embracing her journey as an actress. Your words, your support, and your love mean more than you’ll ever know.

This moment belongs to all of you who believed, who stayed, and who cheered her on with pure intentions. And this is only the beginning. Let’s continue to support Kolette in a positive, loving, and uplifting way, as she takes on more stories and reaches even greater heights.

Let’s keep the momentum going.
Let’s keep celebrating her talent.
Let’s keep believing in her dreams.

And most of all—keep watching What Lies Beneath on Netflix. Keep streaming, keep sharing, and keep letting the world see what we’ve always known: Kolette is someone truly special, and her light is only getting brighter.

So proud. So grateful. So emotional.
This is just the start.

KOLETTE BENEATH THE LIES
